name: medexregai-workspace
description: Runs the MedexRegAI API (server/) and website (client/) together for local development.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && bash scripts/setup-env.sh
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix server && npm run lint --prefix client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix client
